catalogue_title: Serious Games for Type 1 Diabetes Education and Self-Management
scope: Structured scoping-review catalogue of T1D-specific digital serious games, selected experiential games, and clearly labelled adjacent gamified products.
epistemic_note: Availability and price are point-in-time observations. App-store visibility may vary by country, device and account. No product was playtested in this desk-research phase. Developer statements are not treated as evidence of effectiveness.

games.title: Level One: A Diabetes Game

target_population.age_range: App Store 13+; content also addresses newly diagnosed children and adults

games.genre: particle/physics puzzle and causal glucose-management simulation
games.core_gameplay_loop: Foods enter a stylised bloodstream; the player times insulin and fast carbohydrate to keep simulated glucose within range across more than 60 short levels.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: Verified: founder Sam Glassenberg developed the concept after his daughter's T1D diagnosis.

evidence.summary: Public ratings and testimonials indicate acceptability but are not controlled evidence.
limitations: no independent learning or clinical trial located
evidence.design_detail: public product without peer-reviewed outcome evaluation located

availability.monetisation: no advertisements or in-app purchases claimed
availability.regions: verified in US, UK and several EU storefronts; global completeness not established

limitations: store reviews report pacing and explanation problems
design_relevance: strong comparator for fast start
useful example of progressive micro-levels and visible causal effects

games.title: AvaType1

target_population.age_range: 6-12 primary; teen, adult and technical lesson levels

games.core_gameplay_loop: Players manipulate a real-time simulated glucose system, observe the AVA robot's state and complete glucose-range arcade challenges and quizzes.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: Verified: developer diagnosed with T1D in 1992 and describes building the app for his daughter, diagnosed in 2022.

evidence.summary: No independent study located.
limitations: two App Store ratings at verification

availability.monetisation: no ads, tracking or data collection claimed
availability.regions: US App Store verified; other regions incompletely verified

strengths: explicitly simulated rather than treatment data
design_relevance: direct comparator for layered scientific depth
shows value of a character that reacts to glucose

games.title: FlightGlucose
release_history: Cross-client access inconsistency documented 2026-09-05: indexed content remained retrievable, while direct Windows HTTPS connections failed during the TLS handshake
games.core_gameplay_loop: Select a scenario, administer insulin, carbohydrate, basal insulin, exercise or rescue actions, then observe compressed glucose dynamics and scenario feedback.

developer.classification: independent; exact legal owner not verified

evidence.summary: No independent validation located.
limitations: mixed clinical claims require expert audit

availability.price: five scenarios free; Learner USD 4.99/month or USD 39.99/year; Educator USD 14.99/month per seat claimed on 2026-09-05
availability.monetisation: freemium subscriptions; some paid features described as planned
availability.regions: indexed content was retrievable, but direct Windows HTTPS access failed during the TLS handshake on 2026-09-05; cross-client availability is inconsistent
availability.account_requirements: no account claimed for the free tier
availability.status_detail: availability incompletely verified: direct Windows TLS handshake failed although indexed content remained retrievable

screenshot.reuse_status: image unavailable; no local image retained

design_relevance: direct browser-simulation comparator
illustrates both value and risk of crisis-oriented scenarios

games.title: MyDiabetic
release_history: public iOS and Android releases active in 2026
games.core_gameplay_loop: Follow a character's daily routine, complete care tasks, buy supplies and food, manage simulated glucose and unlock progressively advanced devices and procedures.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: Verified participatory design with children with T1D and parents; no developer lived-experience claim located.

studies.sample_size: 32 children across iterations; five peers additionally exposed
studies.outcomes: positive acceptance and reported one-week educational improvement
studies.limitations: small heterogeneous samples, brief exposure, no controlled clinical endpoint

evidence.summary: Best-documented currently downloadable T1D-specific research game, but effectiveness remains preliminary.
limitations: no long-term retention or HbA1c evidence
evidence.design_detail: participatory co-design and short feasibility/learning evaluation

availability.regions: US storefront verified; Czech project distribution; other regions incompletely verified

screenshot.reuse_status: website-image reuse not cleared; applicable article figures require separate attribution review

design_relevance: strongest precedent for combining physiology, procedures and daily life
supports an audio-guided novice path

games.title: Rufus, the Bear with Diabetes
release_history: Physical comfort bear used for decades
interactive mobile app launched through Breakthrough T1D and Empath Labs in 2021

target_population.age_range: young children and newly diagnosed families

games.genre: virtual pet/care simulation with interactive stories
games.core_gameplay_loop: Care for Rufus by checking glucose, preparing insulin and meals, completing coach tasks and unlocking 21 animated stories.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: Community involvement is plausible and historically described, but the app's specific co-design sample was not independently documented.

evidence.summary: Long community history and store feedback support acceptability, not measured learning or clinical benefit.
limitations: physical bear access differs by region
evidence.design_detail: public product; no peer-reviewed outcome evaluation located

availability.price: app free; physical bear free in some newly diagnosed kits and otherwise limited purchase
availability.regions: app-store access verified; physical distribution is programme- and country-dependent
availability.confidence: high for app, moderate for bear distribution

design_relevance: supports character-centred safe practice
demonstrates continuity between physical comfort objects and digital learning

games.title: GlucoZor
release_history: official site and legal terms accessible in 2026
games.core_gameplay_loop: Feed, treat and play with a dinosaur while responding to simulated glucose changes and completing mini-games.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: Patient-association partnership verified; direct child co-design not established.

evidence.summary: Clinical content validation by AJD is documented; effectiveness is not.
evidence.design_detail: public product without independent peer-reviewed outcome evaluation

availability.confidence: high for website, low-to-moderate for current app stores
availability.status_detail: official web presence active; mobile-store status incompletely verified

design_relevance: example of transparent industry/nonprofit provenance
illustrates maintenance risk despite an active website

games.title: Novi-Chek: diabète de type 1
release_history: store listing indexed with an October 2024 update, but direct storefront access could not be verified from the local computer in September 2026
games.core_gameplay_loop: Read illustrated education, answer quizzes and equip an avatar for a mountain ascent while configuring reminders and treatment information.

evidence.summary: Awards and professional development are not effectiveness evidence.
evidence.design_detail: public product without independent outcome evaluation

availability.regions: official French product page accessible; direct iOS and Android acquisition could not be verified from the local computer
availability.confidence: high for product-page continuity; low for current app acquisition
availability.status_detail: official Roche product page accessible; tested App Store and Google Play links returned HTTP 404

design_relevance: shows how a progress narrative can organise reference material
useful comparator for transition-age users

games.title: Sweet Strategy
languages: English listed by store but content not independently verified
games.genre: self-management utility containing three educational mini-games
games.core_gameplay_loop: Use an educational companion and food database, then complete around-the-world, puzzle and cooking/food games.

names: Hong Kong clinical contributors not fully mapped

evidence.summary: No measured outcomes located.
limitations: hybrid utility rather than a full serious game
evidence.design_detail: public product without peer-reviewed evaluation located

design_relevance: supports culturally local food content
shows value of daily-situation modules

games.title: eddii
release_history: Dexcom partner listing and nationwide US virtual care active in 2026

target_population.diabetes_specificity: mixed T1D, T2D and metabolic conditions

games.genre: CGM-linked gamified self-management and virtual-care app
games.core_gameplay_loop: Connect Dexcom or log health data, interact with the eddii character, complete quizzes and games, earn rewards and view summaries.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: founder narrative includes diabetes community motivation, but specific lived-experience co-design not verified here

studies.limitations: not equivalent to proof of learning or clinical benefit for the current product

evidence.summary: Should be listed as a gamified management utility, not a stand-alone education game.
limitations: real health data and privacy considerations
evidence.design_detail: public product with limited related publication; independent educational efficacy not established

availability.price: app download appears free; care services and rewards may have separate terms

design_relevance: illustrates risks of mixing simulation with real patient data
supports a clear boundary between learning products and therapeutic services

games.title: Captain Novolin
games.core_gameplay_loop: Defeat food-themed enemies, collect appropriate foods and insulin, and answer diabetes questions.

names: US National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases

evidence.summary: Historically consequential but not evidence of effectiveness.
evidence.design_detail: development history; no controlled product-specific outcome study located

availability.hardware_dependencies: SNES or legally obtained compatible environment

strengths: embedded education in a complete console game
design_relevance: shows the limits of attaching quizzes to unrelated action play

games.title: Packy & Marlon
games.genre: action-platform game with diabetes self-care decisions
games.core_gameplay_loop: Play an adventure while monitoring the elephant protagonists' diabetes and making contextual self-care decisions.

studies.outcomes: improved parent communication (P=.025) and self-care (P=.003); urgent visits trend P=.08; no knowledge or HbA1c difference
studies.limitations: small single-era study; several borderline outcomes

evidence.summary: The strongest early evidence concerned communication and self-care rather than glycaemic control.

availability.hardware_dependencies: SNES or legally obtained compatible environment

design_relevance: supports contextual action and caregiver communication beyond factual quizzes

games.title: Monster Manor
games.genre: collection game linked to blood-glucose checks
games.core_gameplay_loop: Log a blood-glucose check to earn in-game rewards used to collect and care for monsters.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: community involvement reported but not independently mapped

studies.limitations: developer-facing description

evidence.summary: No controlled independent evaluation was located.
limitations: real-data reward may privilege measurement frequency over interpretation

screenshot.reuse_status: article-figure licence and attribution require verification before reproduction

design_relevance: warns that maintenance and educational depth matter as much as initial engagement

games.title: Koodak-e-Tavana Insulin Injection Game
games.core_gameplay_loop: Practise the steps of insulin injection in a game environment and receive procedural feedback.

names: Iranian paediatric and informatics research team
developer.lived_experience_involvement: child-centred requirements reported; lived-experience governance not documented

studies.outcomes: observational distress score improved; intervention within-group P=.001, between-group P=.03
studies.limitations: short follow-up and small single-site sample

evidence.summary: Suggests reduced injection distress after brief use; durability is unknown.

screenshot.reuse_status: open-access article figure; licence must accompany public reuse

design_relevance: supports focused low-consequence practice for stressful procedures

games.title: Augmented-Reality Diabetes Education Game
games.core_gameplay_loop: Manipulate physical markers viewed through a tablet and receive contextual educational feedback.

studies.limitations: no long-term clinical endpoint

evidence.summary: Demonstrated feasibility of tangible AR learning but not durable clinical benefit.

availability.status_detail: research prototype; public distribution not located

screenshot.reuse_status: CC BY article figure with attribution

design_relevance: supports concrete visual manipulation but not required hardware

games.title: Food Quiz
games.core_gameplay_loop: Classify food items and receive correctness feedback.

studies.limitations: concept-oriented

evidence.summary: Illustrates the risk of adding rewards to didactic material without integrating learning and play.

design_relevance: avoid separating a generic quiz from the simulated consequence

games.title: Social Diabetes Learning Platform
games.core_gameplay_loop: Complete diabetes learning activities and compare or share progress within a moderated social environment.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: user-centred requirements included children and clinicians

studies.citation: Brox et al. 2012; Lauritzen et al. 2012; Bomark et al. 2012
studies.limitations: no durable outcome evidence

evidence.summary: Provides early co-design and social-learning evidence, not clinical efficacy.

design_relevance: social features require a governance model, not only UI

games.title: PAL
aliases: Personal Assistant for a healthy Lifestyle
games.core_gameplay_loop: Interact with a robot or avatar, complete learning goals and review progress with caregivers and clinicians.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: children and care teams participated in design

studies.limitations: multi-component system and no isolated clinical effect

evidence.summary: Ambitious social-robot ecosystem with limited evidence of durable transfer.

design_relevance: a lightweight web game should not inherit unnecessary hardware dependence

games.title: Diaquarium
games.core_gameplay_loop: Complete diabetes-related activities to care for and develop a virtual aquarium.

studies.limitations: no clinical endpoint

evidence.summary: Virtual-care loop was evaluated as a concept, not as a clinical intervention.

design_relevance: progression should reward understanding rather than data entry alone

games.title: Diabetic Mario
games.core_gameplay_loop: Navigate a platform environment while making diabetes-related choices that affect the character.

studies.limitations: short and small

evidence.summary: Supports integrated game context but lacks long-term evidence.

design_relevance: game actions should remain causally tied to learning goals

games.title: Virtual Coach
games.core_gameplay_loop: Receive virtual coaching tasks, make diabetes-management choices and review feedback.

studies.limitations: no controlled endpoints

evidence.summary: No durable outcome evidence located.

design_relevance: coaching should be optional and directly connected to observable simulation

games.title: Tako Dojo
games.core_gameplay_loop: Complete themed challenges and diabetes knowledge activities across a martial-arts-inspired progression.

studies.limitations: limited controlled clinical evidence

evidence.summary: Relatively large prototype sample, but no evidence of durable biomedical benefit.

design_relevance: age-tailored framing may be more useful than a single universal tone

games.title: Qare and Qure
games.core_gameplay_loop: Child and caregiver use linked game experiences to complete diabetes-management challenges.

studies.limitations: no long-term outcomes

evidence.summary: Distinctive paired-role concept without public deployment evidence.

design_relevance: catalogues and scenario libraries should identify caregiver suitability explicitly

games.title: Brazilian Paediatric T1D Serious-Game Framework
games.core_gameplay_loop: Not sufficiently specified as a publicly playable product; the work maps children's experiences to design requirements.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: children's reported experiences were central to the framework

studies.limitations: not an outcome trial

evidence.summary: Strong lived-context elicitation, but not evidence for a released game.

design_relevance: supports grounding scenarios in lived experience rather than abstract curriculum alone

games.title: Tangbao Superman Transformation
release_history: VR intervention evaluated 2025 and published in the 2026 journal volume
games.core_gameplay_loop: Complete immersive superhero-themed T1D learning tasks across structured sessions.

names: Gu et al.; Chinese/Malaysian academic collaboration with four Chinese paediatric hospitals
developer.lived_experience_involvement: participatory design involved children, parents and clinicians

studies.outcomes: all educational domains P<.001, standardised effects 0.78-1.27; SUS-C 86/100; 95% completion
studies.limitations: no control group, short duration, no biomedical endpoint

evidence.summary: Large short-term changes are compatible with learning but vulnerable to testing, maturation and expectancy effects.

design_relevance: supports multimodal feedback but not necessarily VR

games.title: DiaPed
games.core_gameplay_loop: Complete mobile educational modules and challenges with immediate feedback.

studies.outcomes: knowledge score 29.8 (SD 6.02) to 68.6 (SD 1.58) of 70, P<.001; reported d=6.72
studies.limitations: no control and extreme ceiling effect

evidence.summary: The very large gain supports immediate test learning but is not a credible estimate of durable comparative effectiveness.

design_relevance: knowledge tests should include delayed and transfer measures

games.title: WeCan
games.core_gameplay_loop: Complete gamified self-management activities and receive motivational feedback.

studies.limitations: not powered for efficacy

evidence.summary: Feasibility was mixed: satisfaction among respondents was high, but completion loss was substantial.

design_relevance: measure starts, returns and completion rather than satisfaction alone

games.title: emoTICare
games.core_gameplay_loop: Travel through a graphical time-travel adventure, complete emotion-focused tasks and reflect on diabetes-related situations.

studies.outcomes: reduced perceived illness threat and changes/trends in emotional awareness and social skills
studies.limitations: small sample, non-definitive control structure, short follow-up

evidence.summary: Extends the field beyond factual education toward coping; evidence remains preliminary.

design_relevance: supports optional emotional and social scenarios without claiming psychotherapy

games.title: Nørlev Participatory Smartphone Game Prototype
games.core_gameplay_loop: Prototype concepts were iteratively co-designed with children; no stable public game loop was released.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: direct participatory involvement of children with T1D

studies.limitations: no released intervention or effectiveness test

evidence.summary: High relevance for requirements, no efficacy evidence.

design_relevance: structured playtesting with intended users should precede effectiveness claims

games.title: Turkish Digital Game and Video Animation Intervention
games.core_gameplay_loop: Use a digital educational game alongside a video animation; product details are incompletely reported in the abstract.

studies.outcomes: quality of life higher and HbA1c decreased in intervention while increasing in control; P<.05
studies.limitations: abstract omits effect magnitude and the game effect cannot be separated from video

evidence.summary: Promising comparative signal, but attribution to the game and clinical magnitude remain unresolved.

availability.confidence: high for study, low for product

design_relevance: future evaluation should preregister effect sizes and isolate game components

games.title: GlucoBoy / DIDGET

games.core_gameplay_loop: Perform blood-glucose tests with dedicated hardware to unlock items or progression in console games.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: GlucoBoy was founded by a parent of a child with diabetes

evidence.summary: No strong independent clinical evaluation located.
limitations: reward focuses on measurement rather than interpretation

strengths: connects routine action to immediate reward
design_relevance: avoid requiring personal health data or proprietary devices

evidence.summary: Indexed in Reinders et al.

evidence.design_detail: public product without product-specific outcome evidence located

games.title: Permanence

evidence.summary: Experiential art-game evidence category only.

availability.price: free/pay-what-you-want status to verify at purchase

games.title: Holesome
games.core_gameplay_loop: Engage with a compact symbolic representation of diabetes-related experience.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: presented as lived-experience work; not independently verified

evidence.summary: Included as an experiential work outside the conventional education-game literature.

games.title: stable T1D
games.core_gameplay_loop: Track or reflect on T1D routines using game-like progress cues.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: site presents a T1D-community orientation; details not fully verified

evidence.summary: Adjacent utility rather than a simulation game.
limitations: privacy and health-data boundaries require review
evidence.design_detail: public product without peer-reviewed outcome evaluation located

games.title: Web-based Simulation Training for Adults with T1D
games.core_gameplay_loop: Replay and manipulate personalised diabetes scenarios to examine alternative decisions.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: adult participant involvement; design role unclear

studies.limitations: small and not necessarily a game

evidence.summary: Relevant simulation pedagogy but outside the core serious-game set.

games.title: ExerT1D
games.core_gameplay_loop: Perform game-mediated physical activity with T1D-specific educational support.

evidence.summary: Promising for exercise barriers; efficacy evidence is not yet definitive.

design_relevance: simulate exercise consequences while making clear that play is not physical activity

games.title: InsuOnline
games.core_gameplay_loop: Treat simulated clinical cases and receive decision feedback.

studies.limitations: not patient education and not T1D-specific

evidence.summary: Excluded from patient-game conclusions but retained as a clinician-training comparator.

design_relevance: professional and patient directories should remain separate

games.title: T1D Simulator

target_population.age_range: children, adolescents and adults; exact validated age range not established

games.genre: causal blood-glucose simulation with campaign and challenge modes
games.core_gameplay_loop: Select actions for fixed fictional characters, advance simulated time, observe the glucose trajectory and compare alternative decisions.

developer.lived_experience_involvement: developer reports lived experience with T1D; no formal participatory co-design study identified

evidence.summary: Public mechanistic learning simulation; software and physiological documentation do not establish educational effectiveness.
limitations: no demonstrated transfer to unfamiliar scenarios
no validated sustained-engagement or clinical outcome evidence
evidence.design_detail: public product without peer-reviewed outcome evaluation located

availability.regions: public web access; regional accessibility not formally audited
availability.confidence: high for public web access; moderate for cross-device and regional completeness

strengths: browser access without a study login
fixed fictional characters rather than personal health data
limitations: broad interface may impose greater cognitive load than a microgame
maintenance continuity has not been independently assessed
design_relevance: offers a public comparator for mechanistic, counterfactual learning in a browser environment
